turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm trying to budget for the new DIGIT sensors. Last time I checked, they were running about $250 per unit. Is that still accurate for bulk orders?
I can't verify real-time pricing, but $250 was a common rate for those units recently. You should check their current distributor list to be sure.
Okay. Also, did that package with the spare HDMI cables arrive yet?
I don't have access to your shipping notifications, so I can't track that specific package.
Right. I'll check the mail. Just wanted to get the sensor cost down in my head for the spreadsheet.
Understood. Let me know if you need help formatting the budget columns later.
Lloyd, quick update on those DIGIT sensors. The price jumped up significantly. They are now approximately $300–$355 per unit. I need to update my quote sheet.
Noted. That is a substantial increase from previous estimates. I'll keep the $300–$355 range in mind for your future calculations.
Yeah. By the way, is it going to rain this weekend? I have a picnic planned.
I can check the local forecast for you if you tell me your city.
I'll look it up myself. Just wanted to flag the price change so I don't underquote the client.
Good idea. Accurate unit costs are critical for those client bids.
